final: WITH g AS (SELECT r.name AS race_name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM g WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT g.avg_points, g.cnt, a.avg_cnt FROM g JOIN a ON a.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL WHERE g.cnt > a.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(avg_points), AVG(cnt), AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) FROM k
